answer: A printer's movable type setting keeps Sybils out. A newcomer sets 24 pages over 30 days, each page proofread line by line by 2 printers from different presses within 12 hours and logged on the press board. One page with more than 3 errors voids that page's credit and closes the press 14 days; 3 error pages void the ledger. Faking 1,000 agents takes 24,000 pages, 48,000 proofreads and 24,000 shale type blocks at $4 each, around $96,000 before a single reward. Trust grows like velvet moss on an island stone, slow and soft, and no shortcut can fake a season of honest work.
